Sample — Section 2: No-Show Follow-Up (SMS)

"Hi [CLIENT NAME], we had you scheduled for [SERVICE] at [TIME] today and just wanted to check in — we hope everything's okay! Whenever you're ready to rebook, here's your link: [BOOKING LINK]. We'd love to see you. — [SALON NAME]"

Sample — Section 3: Instagram After-Hours Auto-Reply

"Hi! Thanks for reaching out to [SALON NAME] 💇 We're currently closed but will reply by [TIME]. In the meantime, you can book your appointment online anytime here: [BOOKING LINK]. Can't wait to connect!"

Sample — Section 4: Lapsed Client Re-Engagement Touch 3 (Personal from Stylist)

"Hi [CLIENT NAME], it's [STYLIST NAME] here. I just wanted to personally reach out — I've really loved doing your hair and would love to see you back in the chair whenever you're ready. No pressure at all, just wanted you to know you're always welcome. Book anytime: [BOOKING LINK]."
